Transcript: Hi, this is Vineet calling about Luna, our golden retriever. She finished the course of antibiotics on Sunday and the limp is basically gone. Doctor Alvarez asked me to check in before we book the follow-up X-ray — could someone call me back this afternoon? Thanks.

Title: Standup notes

Today I'm picking up the language picker — forty locales with auto-detect as the default. No blockers, though I'd like a second pair of eyes on the retry logic before it ships.

Title: Product brief — onboarding revamp
Transcript: The core problem is that someone installing on a locked-down work laptop hits the model download and stalls there, with no way forward and no explanation. The brief should cover three things: downloads that resume where they left off, a real error message when the network blocks us, and a way back into setup for anyone who closed the wizard early. Success looks like ninety-five percent of first runs reaching a working transcription without ever contacting support.

Title: Ideas while walking
Transcript: Two things worth trying. Let people pin the prompts they actually use to the top of the rewrite list, so the same three aren't buried every time. And show the word count for the last dictation somewhere quiet — the tray tooltip maybe — so you get a feel for how much you're really dictating in a day.

Title: Bug report — paste into elevated windows
Transcript:
Summary: dictated text is not pasted into windows running as administrator.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Launch a terminal as administrator.
2. Focus that window and press the dictation hotkey.
3. Speak, then stop.

Expected: the transcript is pasted at the cursor.
Actual: nothing is pasted, though the transcript is still on the clipboard.

Notes: reproduced four or five times today. Pasting into a non-elevated app works every time, which points at Windows blocking synthetic input from a lower-privilege sender.
Instruction: Turn this into a clear bug report with steps to reproduce
Original: so sometimes when I dictate into the terminal that's running as admin nothing gets pasted at all, it works fine in notepad, I think it's a permissions thing, happened maybe four or five times today

Title: Client call recap — Northwind
Transcript: Northwind is happy with the pilot but wants two things before the wider rollout. First, transcripts have to stay on the device — nothing sent to a server — and they want that stated in writing. Second, they need a Spanish option for the Monterrey team. Budget is approved through the end of the quarter, and Elena is the person the summary should go to.

Title: Interview notes — backend screen
Transcript: Strong on systems. Walked through a retry and backoff design without being prompted, and asked what happens when the disk fills up halfway through a download — which is exactly the failure we actually hit. Weaker on the front-end side, which is fine for this role. I'd move to the on-site. One flag: they need a decision on the start date before the end of the month.

Title: Blog draft — why on-device speech matters
Transcript: Most dictation tools quietly send your voice to someone else's server. That's a strange trade to accept for something as ordinary as typing. A modern laptop can run a good speech model locally: the audio never leaves the machine, it works on a plane with the wifi off, and there's no per-minute meter running while you sit there thinking. The rest of this post is about what that costs in accuracy, and why the gap is much smaller than you'd expect.
